name: Inworld AI
tagline: Realtime voice AI infrastructure for consumer-facing apps.
description: Inworld AI builds the infrastructure for production voice AI: a single Realtime API that unifies speech-to-text, an LLM router, and high-quality text-to-speech so developers can ship interactive voice agents, AI companions, and conversational apps at scale. Its Agent Runtime is free, with usage-based billing for model consumption. Inworld powers voice for a range of fast-growing consumer AI apps.
insight: Launched in 2021 as a game-NPC 'Character Engine,' it pivoted in 2024 to general realtime voice AI infrastructure.

modelSupport.notes: Own realtime TTS/STT models plus an LLM router across providers, on one API.

edge: One API unifies speech-to-text, an LLM router, and a TTS model ranked #1 on Artificial Analysis's blind quality leaderboard — not just a single voice layer.
pros: Unified STT + LLM router + TTS API
